samples.xml_description:
<module id="freq_diveven">
    <description>A frequency divider that divides the input clock frequency by even numbers.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">The input clock signal to be divided.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">An active-low reset signal for initializing the module.</input>
        <output id="clk_div">The divided clock output signal.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <param id="NUM_DIV">The division factor, which must be an even number.</param>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="combinational_logic">
        <reg id="cnt" width_description="[3:0]">A 4-bit register to keep track of the current count value.</reg>
        <reg id="clk_div">The divided clock output signal.</reg>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Initialize cnt and clk_div to 0 when rst_n is low
        if (~rst_n) begin
            cnt <= 4'd0;
            clk_div <= 1'b0;
        end else begin
            // Increment cnt when clk rises and cnt is less than NUM_DIV/2 - 1
            if (clk && cnt < (NUM_DIV >> 1) - 1) begin
                cnt <= cnt + 1;
            end else begin
                // Reset cnt to 0 and toggle clk_div when cnt reaches NUM_DIV/2 - 1
                cnt <= 4'd0;
                clk_div <= ~clk_div;
            end
        end
    </implementation>
</module>
